header: Writes a copy of the section-switch event in 0x0D8F with value 0, 48 clocks (half a beat) after the current position: saves the cursor (slot 1) and position (0x0D5A, 0x371A, 0x0D5C, 0x0D57), seeks forward with DisplayMode_Handler_3_Sub to clock + 48 (0x0DCD = carry unit, 0x0DCE = clock mod 96), sets the record's status to 0xB0 (| 2 when 0x0DC9 bit 1), clock byte = clock + 1, value byte +4 = 0, writes it (SystemInit_StepHandler_0_Helper2, W = 6) and restores position and cursor. Basis: callers + body -- SqStep_ProcessRhythmSectionEvent calls it when the value has any of bits 4-7 (FILL IN / ENDING) set; its header describes this.

header: Returns W = 0 when the cursor track (0x0EEE, 1-16) holds data -- bit 7 of its three-byte entry 0xF250[3 * (track - 1)] is set -- else W = 255; XHL kept. Basis: callers + body -- SqStep_RestoreOnLeave sets the track's bit in the track mask 0xF19E / 0xFFEC only when it returns 0, and the loops at 4255 / 12457 skip tracks for which it is non-zero; SqSngSel_CalcSongUsagePercent counts the same bit as 'used track'.

header: Builds the event bitmap of the grid row above (XIX = 0x372E) or below (XIX = 0x3736): reads events from the block read position into 0x0EB5 (VoiceBank_ProcessCommand), sets bit (clock 0x0EB6 / 12) of the current beat byte for each displayable event (VoiceSlot_StatusCheck W = 0), moves to the next byte on a 0x81 beat marker and stops after (0x0EC1) beats or on 0x84; on the 0x82 end marker in the lower row it records the end position (0x0F5B, 0x0F5A = 3). Basis: callers + body -- SqStep_SetupPrevGridRow and SqStep_SetupNextGridRow call it last with XIX = 0x372E / 0x3736 and 0x0EC1 = the row's beat count; SqStep_BuildCurrentRowBitmap does the same for the current row at 0x3732.
evidence: display/scoop_display.s:5690-5694 `ld xix, 0x372e` / `ld (3777:16), a` / `call VoiceSlot_TableSetup_Helper7` -- caller SqStep_SetupPrevGridRow
display/scoop_display.s:5790-5793 `stb_d8 (0x0ec1), a` / `ld xix, 0x3736` / `call VoiceSlot_TableSetup_Helper7` -- caller SqStep_SetupNextGridRow
display/scoop_display.s:12351-12360 `call VoiceBank_ProcessCommand` / `ld a, (3765:16)` / `call VoiceSlot_StatusCheck` / `cp w, 0:i3`
display/scoop_display.s:12388-12398 `ld a, (3766:16)` / `ld l, 12:opc` / `div wa, l` / `stcf a, (xix)` -- bit = clock / 12
display/scoop_display.s:12403-12406 `inc 1, c` / `cp c, (3777:16)` / `inc 1, xix` -- 0x81 = next beat
display/scoop_display.s:12362-12382 `cp a, 130` / `cp xix, 0x3736` / `ld (3931:16), a` / `ld (3930:16), 3` -- end marker in the lower row
display/scoop_display.s:5578-5587 the same clock / 12 bit set in SqStep_BuildCurrentRowBitmap (0x0F5A = 2 there)

header: Returns in W the track that supplies the measure lengths: when 0x0D54 bit 0 is set, the first track whose TRACK ASSIGN value 0xF1A0[t] is 16 (RHYTHM), as t + 1, with 0x287B bit 2 set; when 0x0D54 bit 0 is clear, W = 0 with 0x287B bit 2 cleared (no RHYTHM track found: W = 0, 0x287B unchanged). Basis: callers + body -- SqStep_SetupPrevGridRow / SqStep_SetupNextGridRow call it before SetWall_SlotResolve, which stores W in 0x288D, the track SetWall_DualPassScanner reads measure lengths from when 0x287B bit 2 is set; SqStep_SetupNextGridRow also resolves the measure on that track itself (`ld a, w`).
evidence: display/scoop_display.s:5626-5630 `ld (0x287f:16), wa` / `call VoiceSlot_TableSetup_Helper8` / `ld a, (3424:16)` / `call SetWall_SlotResolve` -- caller SqStep_SetupPrevGridRow (also 5648, 5676)
display/scoop_display.s:5738-5742 `call VoiceSlot_TableSetup_Helper8` / `cp w, 0:i3` / `ld a, w` / `call SetWall_SlotResolve` -- caller SqStep_SetupNextGridRow resolves on the returned track

ui/setwall_routines.s:1281 `ld (0x288d:16), w` -- SetWall_SlotResolve keeps W
ui/setwall_routines.s:1545-1548 `bit 2, (0x287b:16)` / `ld a, (0x288d:16)` / `call SetWall_SingleSlotResolve` -- that track is resolved for the measure lengths
ui/ui_playback_modes.s:79-84 Seq_FindRhythmTrack header -- 0x0D54 bit 0 / 0x287B bit 2 make the measure lengths come from the RHYTHM track

header: Moves the block read position past four 0x81 beat markers -- from a measure's start to its second grid row (the grid shows at most 4 beats per row) -- stepping one byte at a time (VoiceBank_LoadLerpState / VoiceBank_UpdateLerpState) and stopping before a 0x82 or 0x84 end marker; returns C = the markers passed (4 when complete). Basis: callers + body -- SqStep_SetupNextGridRow calls it for row 2 of the current measure and draws the row only when C = 4; SqStep_SetupPrevGridRow calls it when the previous measure has more than 4 beats (its last row is row 2).
evidence: display/scoop_display.s:5768-5770 `sub a, 4` / `ld (3668:16), a` (beats - 4) / 5786-5787 `call VoiceSlot_TableSetup_Helper9` / `cp c, 4:i3` -- caller SqStep_SetupNextGridRow
display/scoop_display.s:5661-5665 `cp a, 5:i3` / `sub a, 4` / `call VoiceSlot_TableSetup_Helper9` -- caller SqStep_SetupPrevGridRow, measure longer than 4 beats
display/scoop_display.s:13157-13176 `xor bc, bc` / `call VoiceBank_LoadLerpState` / `cp a, 130` / `cp a, 132` / `cp a, 129` / `inc 1, c` / `cp c, 4:i3` / `call VoiceBank_UpdateLerpState`
display/scoop_display.s:5598-5602 SqStep_SetupPrevGridRow header -- rows of at most 4 beats; row 2 = beats - 4

header: Writes the rhythm name into the RHYTHM pop-up line: runs PartCtrl_WriteProgramChange for part 72 ((0x90F7) := 72) with L = program (0x3722) and H = bank (0x0EF5), then AccVoice_DispatchEntry on the HL it returns, which leaves a 13-character name at 0x34AB, and copies those 13 characters to 0x0ED6. Basis: callers + body -- DisplayStr_ShowRhythmLine calls it after writing 'RHYTHM' at 0x0ECF; DisplayStr_BytecodeBlock_D has the same sequence inline for the RHYTHM-track display.
